name: docnest
description: DocNest — Enterprise Document Intelligence & RAG Platform

scripts.dev:backend: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then .venv/bin/uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; else uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; fi'
scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/pytest ]; then PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/pytest tests/; else PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/; fi'
